data.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 3 (INTERMEDIATE). Root cause: _phase_poll in merge-to-main-pr.sh polls gh pr checks and gh pr view state but never checks mergeStateStatus for BEHIND state. When main advances after PR creation and GitHub requires branches to be up-to-date, the PR stays OPEN with all checks green but mergeStateStatus=BEHIND. _phase_poll loops until timeout rather than detecting and updating the branch. Fix: add BEHIND detection in _phase_poll step 2, call gh pr update-branch or git merge + push, then continue polling.
